# Agent Activity Dashboard

Create a comprehensive dashboard showing real-time agent activity, resource usage, success rates, and historical trends. Include metrics like tasks completed, tokens used, average task duration, and error rates.

## Rationale
Addresses pain-6-3 (Devin black box). Provides visibility into autonomous operations, helping users understand performance and optimize their workflows. Builds confidence in AI-powered development.

## User Stories
- As a developer, I want to see agent success rates so that I can identify areas for improvement
- As a budget-conscious user, I want to track token usage so that I can manage API costs

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Real-time view of active agents and their current tasks
- [ ] Success/failure rates displayed with trend graphs
- [ ] Token usage and API cost estimation visible
- [ ] Average task completion time tracked per category
- [ ] Historical data retained for 30+ days
